verses.text: Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj José t'a winh yilumal spat: --Ak' b'ut'jok skoxtal heb' winh tik t'a ixim trigo, yalnhej jantak syal yik'anb'at heb' winh. Tzak'anpaxem k'e'en tumin t'a yol sti' skoxtal junjun heb' winh, haton k'e'en b'aj sman ixim trigo chi' heb' winh.
Tzak'anpaxem k'e'en in kopa plata yet' k'e'en tumin t'a yol sti' skoxtal winh tzak'an unin, xchi winh. Ix sk'anab'ajan winh tas ix yal winhaj José chi'.
Ayik ix ja kopnaj yok k'u t'a k'inhib'alil, ix chaji meltzaj heb' winh yet' nok' schej t'a schonhab'.

Kenanto wal sb'at heb' winh, ix yalan winhaj José t'a winh yilumal spat chi' icha tik: --Ixik tzak'an yuj heb' winh chi'. Ayik syamchaj heb' winh u'uj, tzalani: ¿Tas yuj a swach'k'olal winh in patrón, chukxo tzeyutej he paktzitankani? ¿Tas yuj ix eyelk'ejkot skopa winh, haton jun nab'a plata,
jun skopa winh b'aj syuk' swino, sk'ananpax winh yik sna'anel junok lolonel? Te chuk ix eyutej he b'a a ex tik, xa chi t'a heb' winh, xchi winhaj José chi'.
Ix b'at winh yilumal spat winhaj José chi' b'i'an. Haxo yik ix yamchaj heb' winh yuj winh, ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha ix aj yalan winhaj José chi'.
Ix tak'wi heb' winh t'a winh: --Mamin, ¿tas yuj icha chi' tzutej halan t'ayonh? ¿Tom malaj ko pensar, yuj chi' ol kelk'ejkot junok tasi?
Ina hato t'a Canaán kajan onh. T'a sb'ab'el, a k'e'en tumin ix cheklaj t'a sti' ko koxtal, ix kik'xikot k'e'en. ¿Tom hato wal junok plata ma oro yik winh a patrón chi' ol kelk'ejkot t'a spat?
Ha junok onh b'aj scheklajelta k'e'en kopa chi' t'a yol skoxtal, wach' tato smiljichamok, a onhxo ko masanil, tzonh ochkan a chekab'ok, xchi heb' winh.
Ix tak'wi winh icha tik: --Yik'okab' icha tzeyal chi', palta anhej winh b'aj ol ilchajelta jun kopa chi' wu'uj, a winh chi' ol ochkan in chekab'ok. Ha exxo tik, he masanil libre ex, xchi winh.
T'a elanhchamel ix yak'em skoxtal heb' winh chi' smasanil, ix stijan sti' heb' winh.

Ix sayan yil masanil yoltak koxtal chi' winh. T'a stzolal ix say yil winh, ix sb'ab'laj sayej yil yik winh b'ab'el winak winh masanto t'a winh tzak'an unin. Haxo t'a yol yik winh tzak'an unin chi' ix k'eta k'e'en kopa chi', haton winhaj Benjamín.
Ix och ijan heb' winh snhik'chitan spichul yuj skusk'olal. Ix yak'anxioch yikatz nok' sb'uru heb' winh chi', ix meltzajxi heb' winh t'a spatik.
Ayto ek' winhaj José chi' t'a spat, ix k'och winhaj Judá yet' heb' yuk'tak chi', ix em nhojan heb' winh t'a sat lu'um t'a yichanh winh.
Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --¿Tas yuj icha chi' tzeyutej he b'a? ¿Tom manh eyojtakok to a junok winak ay yopisio icha in tik, syal snachajel junok tas yuj? xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Judá icha tik: --Mamin, ¿tasto wal ol aj ko tak'wi t'ayach? ¿Tasto ol kutok kilanoch ko b'a tato wach' onh kalani? Ay ko mul t'a yichanh ko Mam Dios, tik ayonh ek' t'a ichanh. Syal tzonh och a chekab'ok yet' winh b'aj ix ilchajelta k'e'en kopa chi', xchi winh.
Ix yalanxi winhaj José chi' icha tik: --Ma'ay, anhej winh b'aj ix ilchajelta k'e'en in kopa chi', anhej winh skan in chekab'ok. Ha exxo tik, meltzajanhek t'a junk'olal b'aj ay winh he mam, xchi winh.

Ix snitz wal b'at sb'a winhaj Judá t'a stz'ey winhaj José chi', ix yalan winh: --Mamin, tzok el wal t'a a k'o'ol swalan t'ayach tas in pensar. Tzin tewi t'ayach, mokab' kot owal t'ayin, wach'chom icha ach winh rey.
Ha ach wal ix a k'anb'ej t'ayonh tato aytoek' winh ko mam a onh tik, tato aytopax junokxo kuk'tak.

Yuj chi', ix kalan t'ayach to aytoek' winh ko mam, anhejto te icham winakxo winh. Ha junxo winh kuk'tak tzak'an unin, t'a yicham winakilxo winh ko mam chi' ix alji winh. Haxo junxo winh junnhej snun winh yet'ok, chamnakxo winh, yuj chi' te xajan winh yuj winh ko mam chi', yujto haxonhej winh.
Ha ach ix ala' to skik'kot winh, yik tzojtakejel winh.
Ix kalan t'ayach to max yal sk'ol winh ko mam chi' tz'elta winh t'a stz'ey, yujto ijanxo scham winh yuj kusk'olal yalani tato tz'el winh t'a stz'ey winh.
Palta ix alpax t'ayonh tato max kik'kot winh, maxtzak yal ko jax t'a ichanh halani.
Ayik ix onh k'och t'a ko pat chi', ix kalan t'a winh ko mam chi' tas ix aj halan t'ayonh.
Haxo winh ix halan t'ayonh to tzonh kotxi manoj trigo.
Ix kalan t'a winh icha tik: Max onh b'atlaj tato max kik'b'at winh kuk'tak tzak'an unin tik, yujto tato max b'at winh ket'ok, maxtzak yal-laj ko k'och t'a yichanh winh yajal chi', xko chi.
Ix yalan winh ko mam chi' t'ayonh: Eyojtak to chawannhej wuninal ix wil yet' ix wetb'eyum chamnak.
Jun winh junelnhej b'atnakkani, manhxa b'aj ix wil sat winh, ay am wal junok nok' nok' chium anima chi'annakb'at winh.
Tato tzeyik'xib'at junxo winh tik, tato ay pax tas tz'ik'an winh, eyuj am wal tzin cham yuj kusk'olal, xchi winh t'ayonh.
Yuj chi', icha wal to sk'inal winh ko mam chi' yajoch winh wuk'tak tik. Tato manhxo ol meltzaj winh ket'ok
ol cham winh ko mam yuj kusk'olal, a onh tik tz'och ko mul.
Ha in ix in tek'b'ej in b'a yuj winh t'a winh in mam chi', ix walani: Tato manhxo ol jax winh wu'uj, te chuk tzin kan t'a yol a sat t'a junelnhej, xin chi t'a winh in mam chi'.
Yuj wal chi' tzin tewi t'ayach, tato syala', a in tzin kan sk'exulok winh wuk'tak tik a chekab'ok. Yuj chi' tzaktejel winh, spax winh yet' heb' winh wuk'tak tik.
Tato ma'ay jun, ¿tasto wal ol aj in b'at wil winh in mam chi', tato manhok jun winh wet'ok? Manh jab'ok syal in k'ol swil skusk'olal winh in mam tato icha chi' tzuji, xchi winhaj Judá chi'.
